description.en: BreezeTTS 2 native GGUF package for instruction-conditioned text-to-speech and prompt-audio voice cloning with T5Gemma text conditioning, Qwen-style acoustic code generation, depth codebook decoding, and Mimi waveform decoding.
description.zh: BreezeTTS 2 原生 GGUF 包，支持指令条件文本转语音与提示音频音色克隆，采用 T5Gemma 文本条件、Qwen 风格声学码生成、深度码本解码与 Mimi 波形解码。

reference_text.en: Transcript for prompt/reference audio; required when reference audio codes are used, for either tts or clon
reference_text.zh: 参考音频的转写文本，在 tts 或 clon 任务中使用参考音频时必填

max_tokens.en: Maximum acoustic frames per audio segment (about 12.5 frames per second)
max_tokens.zh: 每段音频的声学帧生成上限（每秒约 12.5 帧）

guidance_scale.en: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale for adjusting how closely the output follows the instruction and voice
guidance_scale.zh: 无分类器引导（CFG）系数，用于调整指令与音色的贴合程度

temperature.en: Backbone sampling temperature for overall pronunciation randomness
temperature.zh: 主干网络采样温度，调整整体发音的随机性

top_k.en: Top-k sampling: at each generation step, sample only from the K most probable candidates
top_k.zh: Top-k 采样，生成过程中每次只从概率最高的前 K 个候选中选择

top_p.en: Top-p sampling: at each generation step, keep candidates by cumulative probability until the configured threshold is reached
top_p.zh: Top-p 采样，生成过程中每次按累计概率保留候选，直到达到设定值

seed.en: Random seed: a fixed value makes results reproducible, and changing it produces different results
seed.zh: 随机种子，固定后可复现，改变会得到不同结果

text_chunk_size.en: Maximum characters per long-form text chunk
text_chunk_size.zh: 长文本分段的最大字符数

depth_temperature.en: Depth decoder sampling temperature for randomness in timbre details
depth_temperature.zh: 深度解码器采样温度，调整音色细节的随机性

stream_frames_per_event.en: Maximum generated codec frames per streaming audio event; fixed size with stream_chunk_policy=fixed
stream_frames_per_event.zh: 每个流式音频事件最多生成的编解码帧数，stream_chunk_policy=fixed 时使用固定帧数

stream_lookahead_margin.en: Additional trailing codec frames buffered before streaming emission. The decoder is causal; zero minimizes latency
stream_lookahead_margin.zh: 流式输出前额外缓冲的尾部编解码帧数，解码器为因果结构，0 表示最小延迟

stream_chunk_policy.en: Streaming chunk schedule: grow emits 1, 2, 4, ... frames up to stream_frames_per_event; fixed uses that size from the first event
stream_chunk_policy.zh: 流式分块策略，grow 依次输出 1、2、4……帧，直至 stream_frames_per_event，fixed 从第一个事件起使用该固定帧数
